mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_LeastPrivilege allows the model to generate an AuditEntry where a HospitalAdministrator has outcome=Permitted for RecordLookup or a Doctor has outcome=Permitted for AuditSearch. The injected fact forces exactly such a violating instance.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeastPrivilegeViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.accessor.role = HospitalAdministrator and ae.opKind = RecordLookup and ae.outcome = Permitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_CareTeamGating allows a Permitted clinical access to exist without any ActiveMembership row. The injected fact forces a Permitted RecordLookup for a user/patient pair with no membership, which violates OwnershipBasedAccess and FR_004_CareTeamGating.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CareTeamGatingViolation { some ae: AuditEntry, u: User, p: Patient | ae.accessor = u and ae.auditPatient = p and ae.opKind = RecordLookup and ae.outcome = Permitted and u.role = Doctor and no m: ActiveMembership | m.clinician = u and m.patient = p }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AdminCannotAddNote allows the model to create a ClinicalNote whose author holds the HospitalAdministrator role. The injected fact forces exactly this, violating the content-blindness and clinical-authorship invariants.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AdminCannotAddNoteViolation { some n: ClinicalNote | n.author.role = HospitalAdministrator }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AuditCompleteness allows a ClinicalNote to exist with no corresponding AddNote+Permitted AuditEntry. The injected fact forces a note to exist with no matching audit event, directly violating always-on-audit and append-only correctness.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditCompletenesViolation { some n: ClinicalNote | no ae: AuditEntry | ae.opKind = AddNote and ae.outcome = Permitted and ae.noteRef = n }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AppendOnlyAuditEntries allows two structurally identical AuditEntries to coexist, representing duplicate (phantom) records of the same event — a form of audit tampering. The injected fact forces two distinct AuditEntry atoms with identical content tuples.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyAuditViolation { some disj ae1, ae2: AuditEntry | ae1.accessor = ae2.accessor and ae1.auditPatient = ae2.auditPatient and ae1.opKind = ae2.opKind and ae1.outcome = ae2.outcome and ae1.authBasis = ae2.authBasis and ae1.noteRef = ae2.noteRef }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AdminContentBlindness allows a non-administrator user to trigger an AuditSearch, meaning a clinical-role caller could access the audit endpoint. The injected fact forces a Doctor to appear as the accessor on an AuditSearch entry, violating administrator-only access.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AdminContentBlindnessViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.opKind = AuditSearch and ae.accessor.role = Doctor }
